exams.name: GATE Computer Science & Information Technology (CS)
exams.full_title: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering — Computer Science (CS)
exams.overview: GATE CS is a national computer-based examination conducted jointly by IISc Bangalore and 7 IITs on behalf of the National Coordination Board (NCB-GATE), Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. It assesses comprehensive understanding of undergraduate computer science concepts for Master's/Direct Ph.D. admissions at IITs, NITs, and IIITs, and executive recruitment across Maharatna and Navratna Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).
exams.eligibility: Candidates currently studying in 3rd or higher years of any undergraduate degree program OR already completed any government-approved degree in Engineering / Technology / Science / MCA.
exams.educational_qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc (Computer Science / IT / Mathematics / Statistics) or equivalent.
exams.current_notification: GATE 2027 Registration Portal active at official IIT organising institute portal from August to October.

topic_wise_syllabus.Engineering Mathematics: Discrete Mathematics (Propositional and first order logic, Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices, Monoids, Groups, Graphs, Combinatorics), Linear Algebra (Matrices, determinants, system of linear equations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors), Calculus, Probability and Statistics.
topic_wise_syllabus.Programming and Data Structures: Programming in C, Recursion, Arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, binary search trees, binary heaps, graphs.
topic_wise_syllabus.Algorithms: Searching, sorting, hashing, Asymptotic worst and average time complexity analysis. Greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, divide-and-conquer, Graph traversals, Minimum spanning trees, Shortest paths.
topic_wise_syllabus.Theory of Computation: Regular expressions and finite automata. Context-free grammars and push-down automata. Regular and context-free languages, pumping lemma. Turing machines and undecidability.
topic_wise_syllabus.Operating System: Processes, threads, inter-process communication, concurrency and synchronization, deadlocks, CPU and I/O scheduling, Memory management and virtual memory, File systems.

exams.what_to_study: Focus deeply on conceptual clarity from standard textbooks, solve all 35-year previous GATE CS questions topic-wise, and take full-length mock tests under real time constraints.

Complete subject syllabus notes. 3. Solve previous 20 years papers topic-wise. 4. Devote last 60 days exclusively to full-length mocks and error analysis.

Revision of Data Structures, Algorithms, Theory of Computation, and Compiler Design.
Revision of Operating Systems, DBMS, Computer Networks, and Digital Logic.

exams.name: GATE Mechanical Engineering (ME)
exams.full_title: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering — Mechanical Engineering (ME)
exams.overview: GATE Mechanical Engineering is the primary national examination for M.Tech admissions at IITs/IISc and executive engineering engineer-trainee selections at India's top PSUs (ONGC, IOCL, NTPC, BHEL, GAIL, SAIL, HPCL, BPCL, BARC, and ISRO).
exams.eligibility: Candidates in 3rd or final year B.Tech Mechanical / Production / Automobile / Aerospace or degree holders.
exams.educational_qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or allied disciplines recognized by AICTE.
exams.current_notification: GATE 2027 Registration Portal active at official IIT organising institute portal.

topic_wise_syllabus.Applied Mechanics and Design: Engineering Mechanics (free-body diagrams, trusses, friction), Strength of Materials (stress, strain, Mohr circle, bending and shear stresses, deflection of beams, torsion), Theory of Machines (kinematics, governors, flywheels, balancing), Vibrations, Machine Design (fatigue strength, design of shafts, gears, bearings).
topic_wise_syllabus.Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences: Fluid Mechanics (fluid statics, Bernoulli equation, boundary layer, pipe flow), Heat Transfer (conduction, convection, radiation, heat exchangers), Thermodynamics (laws of thermodynamics, thermodynamic cycles, availability), Applications (Power Engineering, IC Engines, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning, Turbomachinery).
topic_wise_syllabus.Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial: Engineering Materials (phase diagrams, heat treatment), Casting, Forming and Joining Processes, Machining and Machine Tool Operations, Metrology and Inspection, Computer Integrated Manufacturing, Production Planning and Control, Operations Research.

exams.what_to_study: Thermal and Fluid Sciences (28%), Manufacturing & Industrial (25%), Mechanics and Machine Design (22%), Engineering Math (15%), Aptitude (15%).

exams.name: JEE Main (Joint Entrance Examination)
exams.overview: JEE (Main) is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to undergraduate engineering programs (B.Tech/B.Arch) at NITs, IIITs, other Centrally Funded Technical Institutions (CFTIs), and serves as the screening test for JEE (Advanced) for admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs).
exams.eligibility: Class 12th passed in current year or preceding two years with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Biotechnology.
exams.educational_qualification: 10+2 Intermediate (MPC stream) from any recognized Central or State Board of Secondary Education.
exams.age_criteria: No age limit for appearing in JEE (Main).
exams.current_notification: JEE Main Session 1 (January) and Session 2 (April) annual notifications published on nta.ac.in and jeemain.nta.nic.in.

topic_wise_syllabus.Mathematics: Sets, Relations, Functions, Complex Numbers, Quadratic Equations, Matrices and Determinants, Permutations and Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Sequences and Series, Differential and Integral Calculus, Differential Equations, Coordinate Geometry, Vectors and 3D Geometry, Statistics and Probability, Trigonometry.
topic_wise_syllabus.Physics: Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work Energy and Power, Rotational Motion, Gravitation, Properties of Solids and Liquids, Thermodynamics, Kinetic Theory of Gases, Oscillations and Waves, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism, Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents, Optics, Dual Nature of Matter, Atoms and Nuclei, Electronic Devices.
topic_wise_syllabus.Chemistry: Physical Chemistry (Some Basic Concepts, Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding, Chemical Thermodynamics, Solutions, Equilibrium, Redox Reactions, Chemical Kinetics), Inorganic Chemistry (Periodic Table, p-block, d and f-block, Coordination Compounds), Organic Chemistry (Purification, Hydrocarbons, Organic compounds containing Halogens, Oxygen, Nitrogen, Biomolecules).

exams.what_to_study: Master NCERT textbooks line-by-line for Chemistry; practice H.C. Verma and PYQs for Physics; solve multi-concept analytical questions for Mathematics.

exams.name: NEET (UG) — National Eligibility cum Entrance Test
exams.full_title: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) — NTA
exams.overview: NEET (UG) is India's single national entrance examination conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to undergraduate medical (MBBS), dental (BDS), AYUSH (BAMS, BHMS, BUMS), veterinary (BVSc & AH), and B.Sc Nursing courses across all government and private medical colleges, including AIIMS and JIPMER.
exams.eligibility: Passed 10+2 Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects.
exams.educational_qualification: 10+2 Intermediate (BiPC stream) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate in PCB (40% for SC/ST/OBC).
exams.age_criteria: Minimum 17 years completed on or before 31st December of the year of admission. No upper age limit.
exams.current_notification: Annual notification released in February; Pen & Paper offline exam conducted on the first Sunday of May.

topic_wise_syllabus.Biology: Diversity in Living World, Structural Organisation in Animals and Plants, Cell Structure and Function, Plant Physiology, Human Physiology, Reproduction, Genetics and Evolution, Biology and Human Welfare, Biotechnology and Its Applications, Ecology and Environment.
topic_wise_syllabus.Physics: Units and Measurements, Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work, Energy, Power, System of Particles and Rotational Motion, Gravitation, Mechanical Properties of Solids and Fluids, Thermal Properties of Matter, Thermodynamics, Oscillations and Waves, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects, Optics, Modern Physics.
topic_wise_syllabus.Chemistry: Chemical Bonding, Thermodynamics, Equilibrium, Solutions, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Coordination Compounds, Hydrocarbons, Haloalkanes, Alcohols, Carbonyl Compounds, Amines, Biomolecules.

exams.what_to_study: NCERT Biology Class 11 and 12 is 100% compulsory (accounting for 360/720 marks). Chemistry NCERT for Inorganic & Organic. Physics conceptual numerical practice.

exams.name: AP ECET (Engineering Common Entrance Test)
exams.full_title: Andhra Pradesh Engineering Common Entrance Test (Lateral Entry)
exams.overview: AP ECET is conducted by the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) for Diploma holders and B.Sc (Mathematics) graduates for direct lateral entry admission into the 2nd year (3rd semester) of regular B.Tech / B.E. programs in university and private engineering colleges across Andhra Pradesh.
exams.eligibility: Diploma in Engineering and Technology from the State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET) with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories).
exams.educational_qualification: 3-Year State Board Technical Board Diploma in relevant branch or B.Sc with Mathematics.
exams.current_notification: Annual notification issued in March; exam conducted in May.
subjects: Selected Engineering Discipline Branch Subject (100 Marks)

topic_wise_syllabus.Engineering Mathematics: Matrices, Partial Fractions, Trigonometry, Analytical Geometry, Differential Calculus, Integration and its applications, Differential Equations, Laplace Transforms, Fourier Series.
topic_wise_syllabus.Physics: Units and Dimensions, Elements of vectors, Kinematics and Friction, Work, Power and Energy, Simple Harmonic Motion, Heat and Thermodynamics, Sound, Electricity and Magnetism, Modern Physics.
topic_wise_syllabus.Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding, Solutions, Acids and Bases, Electrochemistry, Corrosion, Water Technology, Polymers, Fuels, Environmental Chemistry.
topic_wise_syllabus.Branch Engineering: Covers all 3-year SBTET core subjects in the candidate's respective diploma stream (e.g. Data Structures & OS for CSE, Strength of Materials & Thermodynamics for Mechanical, Circuit Theory & Power Systems for EEE, Structural Engineering & Surveying for Civil).

exams.what_to_study: 100 marks out of 200 come from your Diploma Branch subjects! Focus heavily on 2nd and 3rd year technical board subjects, followed by Engineering Mathematics (50 marks).

exams.full_title: Andhra Pradesh Polytechnic Common Entrance Test
exams.overview: AP POLYCET is conducted by the State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET), Andhra Pradesh for admission into 3-Year Diploma courses in Engineering & Non-Engineering trades offered by Government, Aided, and Private unaided polytechnics across Andhra Pradesh.
exams.eligibility: Passed or appeared for SSC (Class 10th) examination conducted by Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh or equivalent with Mathematics as one of the subjects.
exams.current_notification: Notification published annually in February/March; offline pen-and-paper exam conducted in April/May.

topic_wise_syllabus.Physics: Heat, Chemical Reactions and Equations, Reflection of Light at Curved Surfaces, Refraction of Light at Curved Surfaces, Human Eye and Colourful World, Structure of Atom, Classification of Elements, Chemical Bonding, Electric Current, Electromagnetism, Principles of Metallurgy, Carbon and its Compounds.

exams.what_to_study: Class 10th State Board Mathematics and Physical Science textbooks cover 100% of the AP POLYCET question paper.

exams.name: UPSC NDA & NA Examination
exams.full_title: National Defence Academy & Naval Academy Examination — UPSC
exams.overview: Conducted twice a year by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) for recruiting candidates as commissioned officers into the Army, Navy, and Air Force wings of the National Defence Academy (NDA), Khadakwasla, Pune, and the 10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme of the Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala.
exams.eligibility: Unmarried male and female candidates who have passed or are appearing in Class 12th. For Air Force and Navy wings: Physics and Mathematics are compulsory.
exams.educational_qualification: 10+2 Intermediate (Army wing: any stream; Navy & Air Force wings: MPC stream).
exams.age_criteria: Between 16.5 and 19.5 years as of course commencement date.
exams.current_notification: UPSC NDA-I (April exam, January notification) and NDA-II (September exam, May notification) on upsc.gov.in.
subjects: General Ability Test (GAT - Paper II - 600 Marks)

topic_wise_syllabus.Mathematics: Algebra, Matrices and Determinants, Trigonometry, Analytical Geometry of 2D and 3D, Differential Calculus, Integral Calculus and Differential Equations, Vector Algebra, Statistics and Probability.
topic_wise_syllabus.General Ability Test: Part A - English (200 Marks: Grammar, vocabulary, comprehension); Part B - General Knowledge (400 Marks: Physics, Chemistry, General Science, History & Freedom Movement, Geography, Current Events).

exams.what_to_study: Class 11 & 12 Mathematics (focus on speed shortcuts), English grammar & vocabulary, Indian History, Geography, and current national/international defence affairs.

exams.name: SSC Junior Engineer (JE)

exams.eligibility: Diploma or Degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute.
exams.educational_qualification: 3-Year Diploma or 4-Year B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.
exams.age_criteria: Up to 30 years (up to 32 years for CWC & CPWD) with government age relaxations for OBC/SC/ST/PwD.
exams.current_notification: Annual notification published on ssc.gov.in; Computer Based Exam Paper 1 held in May/June, Paper 2 in October.

topic_wise_syllabus.Civil Engineering: Building Materials, Estimating, Costing and Valuation, Surveying, Soil Mechanics, Hydraulics, Irrigation Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Structural Engineering, Concrete Technology, RCC Design, Steel Design.
topic_wise_syllabus.Mechanical Engineering: Theory of Machines, Machine Design, Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Thermal Engineering, Fluid Mechanics, Hydraulic Turbines, Centrifugal Pumps, Manufacturing Engineering.
topic_wise_syllabus.Electrical Engineering: Basic concepts, Circuit law, Magnetic Circuit, AC Fundamentals, Measurement and measuring instruments, Electrical Machines, Synchronous Machines, Generation, Transmission and Distribution, Estimation and costing, Utilization of Electrical Energy, Basic Electronics.

exams.what_to_study: 100 marks technical engineering + 50 marks Reasoning. High score in technical domain and reasoning guarantees Paper-1 qualification.

exams.name: UGC NET (National Eligibility Test)
exams.full_title: University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test — NTA
exams.overview: UGC NET is conducted biannually (June and December cycles) by the National Testing Agency on behalf of the University Grants Commission for determining the eligibility of Indian nationals for 'Assistant Professor' as well as 'Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and Assistant Professor' in Indian universities and colleges.
exams.eligibility: Master's Degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwD, Third gender). Candidates in final year of Master's degree are also eligible.
exams.educational_qualification: Postgraduate Degree (M.Tech, M.Sc, M.Com, MA, MBA, MCA) in relevant discipline.
exams.age_criteria: For JRF: Maximum 30 years (with up to 5 years relaxation for reserved categories and women). For Assistant Professor: No upper age limit.
exams.current_notification: Notifications released in April (June cycle) and October (December cycle) on ugcnet.nta.ac.in.
subjects: Paper I: General Paper on Teaching and Research Aptitude (50 Questions - 100 Marks)
Paper II: Subject-Specific Core (100 Questions - 200 Marks)

topic_wise_syllabus.Paper I: Teaching Aptitude, Research Aptitude, Reading Comprehension, Communication, Mathematical Reasoning and Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, Data Interpretation, Information and Communication Technology (ICT), People, Development and Environment, Higher Education System.
topic_wise_syllabus.Paper II: In-depth specialization syllabus based on Master's discipline (e.g. Computer Science and Applications, Management, Commerce, Economics, English, Physical Sciences).

exams.what_to_study: Master Paper 1 (target 70+ marks out of 100) using previous papers; revise core Master's syllabus thoroughly for Paper 2.

study_materials.title: UGC Official Subject-Wise Syllabus PDFs (All 83 Subjects)

recommended_books.book_name: UGC NET/JRF/SET Teaching and Research Aptitude (General Paper-I)
recommended_books.author: K.V.S. Madaan
recommended_books.subject: Paper 1 (Teaching & Research Aptitude)
recommended_books.purpose: Comprehensive theory, pedagogy concepts, ICT, and environment for Paper 1.

previous_year_papers.title: UGC NET June & December 2024 Official Papers

mock_tests.title: NTA National Test Abhyas UGC NET Mock Modules

exams.preparation_strategy: 1. Solve all Paper 1 questions from 2018 to 2024. 2. Connect research terminology with practical thesis methodology. 3. Target JRF cutoff (top 1% merit) for monthly fellowship of ~Rs. 37,000 + HRA.

3_months.focus: Complete Paper 1 all 10 units + 1 hour daily Paper 2 core theory.
Paper 2 unit-wise deep study with previous year question tagging.
Full length 3-hour mock tests combining Paper 1 and Paper 2 without break.

exams.application_info: Online application on ugcnet.nta.ac.in. Fee: General Rs. 1150, Gen-EWS/OBC Rs. 600, SC/ST/PwD Rs. 325.
exams.admit_card: Downloadable 4 days before exam date on NTA website.
exams.result: Scorecards, Percentiles, and e-Certificates published on ugcnet.nta.ac.in.
exams.counselling_info: Direct eligibility for Assistant Professor recruitment in central/state universities and JRF fellowship enrollment.
